algorithm_name: P2 component balance and shared input waves
method_description: Structural component-work imbalance triggers tensor DAG split; overcapacity shared input uses guarded waves; retains prior word/tree/vector guards. No score tables or online scoring.
case_selection: Three weakest shared-input family graphs from fixed full500 audit; not a full-suite performance result.
failure_policy: First unsuccessful or unverified attempt stops; no retry.
resources: One macOS worker; each cell 1 solver and 1 final E0, three cells 270s aggregate, sampled4GiB RSS. Wait for s59 release. No Colab.
offline_costs: Existing20 synthetic tests and existing static wave constructions; no new training or evaluation.
comparison: Compare same case/core to fixed b7 full500 data571536; measure both makespan and DDR/spill. Raw static peaks are not a zero-spill guarantee.
